newsitem.title: USA: BPA raises Wed non-firm peak power by $2/MWh.
newsitem.headline: BPA raises Wed non-firm peak power by $2/MWh.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) raised prices for non-firm power during "valley peaks" by $2.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for Wednesday deliveries, the agency said Tuesday.
BPA offered non-firm power during hours ending at 1200-1700 PDT and 2100-2200 PDT at $13.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for Northwest deliveries and $14.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) deliveries.
The agency continued to refrain from offering surplus power during morning and evening peaks.

Non-firm power for hours ending at 0600 PDT and 2300 PDT was still offered at $9.50 for all deliveries, while supplies during off-peak hours ending at 0100-0500 PDT and 2400 PDT were unchanged at $9.00.
Firm power during off-peak hours on Wednesday was also unchanged at $9.00.
BPA again placed no volume limits on the sales offers.
